name: Jun Zhou
title: Computer Graphics Researcher
bio: Jun Zhou is a computer graphics researcher based in China. He was a Postdoc Associate at the Yale Graphics Group (2024–2026) and received his PhD from the University of Groningen in 2023. His research includes jewelry relighting in virtual try-on and spectral reconstruction, subdivision surfaces, and numerical quadratures for Gregory patches.

name: Holly Rushmeier
title: Professor of Computer Science
bio: Professor Holly Rushmeier leads the Yale Graphics Group. Jun Zhou's postdoctoral research on jewelry relighting in virtual try-on and spectral reconstruction was under her guidance.

name: Jiří Kosinka
title: Associate Professor
bio: Jiří Kosinka is Jun Zhou's PhD advisor at the University of Groningen, working in Scientific Visualization and Computer Graphics.

name: Jos B.T.M. Roerdink
title: Professor of Computer Science
bio: Jos B.T.M. Roerdink was a PhD advisor of Jun Zhou at the University of Groningen.
